What We Use

Our Ingredients

Every fragrance begins with nature. We source only the finest botanicals, resins and spices — chosen for their purity, character and depth.

01

Pink Pepper

Schinus molle

Warm, spicy and vibrant. Pink pepper adds an energetic spark to the opening of a fragrance — fresh and bold without the harshness of black pepper.

Found in: Sahara Orange · Midnight Breeze
02

Italian Bergamot

Citrus bergamia

Sun-drenched and luminous. Bergamot is the soul of the classic citrus opening — floral, slightly sweet and unmistakably Mediterranean. Sourced from the sun-drenched groves of Calabria, Italy.

Found in: Sahara Orange · White Breeze
03

Saffron

Crocus sativus

The most precious spice in the world. Saffron brings a warm, honeyed depth to our fragrances — earthy, exotic and unmistakably Arabian. Each thread is hand-harvested from the crocus flower at dawn.

Found in: Asrar Collection
The Art of Oud

Where Nature Meets Luxury

The iris flower and oud wood have been treasured for centuries across Arabia and the world. Their union represents the very essence of Secret of Oud — raw, natural beauty transformed into something extraordinary.

Every drop of oud we use is carefully sourced, aged, and crafted into fragrances that honour this ancient tradition while speaking to the modern world.

The Essence of Lavender

Calm. Pure. Unforgettable.

Lavender is one of nature's most treasured gifts — calming, elegant and timeless. Found at the heart of both Phantom Breeze and Scarlet Breeze, it brings balance and depth to every fragrance it touches.

We source only the finest lavender, capturing its full essence — from the fresh, herbal opening to its warm, lingering heart.
